goal.label: Goal
goal.prompt: Describe what you want the system to accomplish.
goal.teaching: The goal determines the required artifacts, verification, and whether physical hardware is involved.

modulation.label: Modulation
modulation.prompt: Select or enter a modulation scheme.

protocol.label: Protocol
protocol.prompt: Select or enter a communication protocol.

hardware.label: Device
hardware.prompt: Select the SDR you will actually use; the system will later verify the discovered model.

local_name.label: Advertising name
local_name.prompt: Enter the BLE Complete Local Name that an external receiver should display.

carrier_frequency.label: Carrier
carrier_frequency.prompt: Select or enter the center frequency.

sample_rate.label: Sample rate
sample_rate.prompt: Select or enter the sample rate.

duration_seconds.label: Maximum duration
duration_seconds.prompt: What is the maximum allowed duration for this physical operation? A safe default is only a suggestion and requires your confirmation.

success_conditions.label: Success condition
success_conditions.prompt: What observable evidence should determine whether the task succeeded?

choices.label: Observed by an independent receiver
choices.value: An independent receiver observes the target signal

choices.label: Receiver screenshot or capture
choices.value: Attach receiver screenshot or capture evidence

ebn0_db.label: Eb/N0
ebn0_db.prompt: Select or enter the Eb/N0 for the BER simulation.

current_project.label: Current project
current_project.prompt: Open the .grc project to inspect in GRC, then select 'Current project is open'.

direction.label: Direction
direction.teaching: Direction is one of three classes: tx for a transmit chain, rx for a receive chain, and sim for an offline simulation that does not drive physical RF.

operation.label: Operation
operation.prompt: Specify whether to generate/configure only or to run the system.

bandwidth.label: Bandwidth
bandwidth.prompt: Specify the bandwidth. If there is no special constraint, a value matched to the sample rate can be suggested.
bandwidth.teaching: Bandwidth affects filters, the hardware analog filter bandwidth, and receiver noise.

payload.label: Payload
payload.prompt: Describe the signal or protocol payload.

ble_mode.label: BLE role
ble_mode.prompt: Specify the BLE operation, such as advertising, scanning, or connected-mode transceiving.

wifi_role.label: Wi-Fi role
wifi_role.prompt: Specify the Wi-Fi role, such as transmitting data frames, sending beacons, or receiving.

wifi_standard.label: Wi-Fi standard
wifi_standard.prompt: Specify the Wi-Fi standard. If uncertain, describe the band, bandwidth, and compatibility target.

wifi_channel.label: Wi-Fi channel
wifi_channel.prompt: Specify the Wi-Fi channel or center frequency.

ssid.label: SSID
ssid.prompt: Specify the SSID that should appear in the beacon/AP frame.

tx_gain.label: TX gain
tx_gain.prompt: Specify the transmit gain. If uncertain, a safe suggestion will be used and confirmed before transmission.

tx_attenuation.label: TX attenuation
tx_attenuation.prompt: Specify the transmit attenuation. If uncertain, a safe suggestion will be used and confirmed before transmission.

expected_signal.label: Expected signal
expected_signal.prompt: Describe the signal you expect to receive or observe.

capture_duration.label: Capture duration
capture_duration.prompt: Specify the receive or capture duration.

requested_metrics.label: Metrics
requested_metrics.prompt: Specify the metrics to inspect, such as spectrum, EVM, or BER.

diagnosis_target.label: Diagnosis target
diagnosis_target.prompt: Specify whether to diagnose the device, flowgraph, runtime error, or signal quality.

diagnosis_dimensions.label: Diagnosis dimensions
diagnosis_dimensions.prompt: Specify the dimensions to inspect, or let the system choose the minimum check set for the problem.
